summary: Verified the checkbox rendering fix on /inscricao.html for #declaracao_veracidade. Computed styles show overflow:visible, transform:none, width/height 18px. Parent label uses display:flex, align-items:flex-start, overflow:visible. Checkbox bounding rect is fully within parent label (no clipping on any side). Click toggles checked state correctly (false -> true -> false). Screenshot confirms all 4 sides of the checkbox are rendered as a complete square. Only one checkbox exists on the current page (the declaration one); no other checkboxes to regress-test at this stage of the form.
critical_code_review_comments: Global rule 'body *{overflow:hidden}' in the template is a footgun and forced this specific override. Consider scoping the overflow rule (e.g., only to layout containers) to prevent recurrence on other form controls added in the future.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified visually and via getComputedStyle. Checkbox 18x18, overflow visible, transform none, no clipping vs parent label. Toggle works. Only one checkbox present on this page in current form state; PCD/atendimento especial checkboxes may appear only in later steps and were not reachable here.
rca of the issue: Root cause: global CSS 'body *{overflow:hidden}' combined with transform:scale(1.15) on the checkbox caused the 18px checkbox to render at 20.7px and be clipped by its own overflow:hidden box and the parent label's overflow:hidden. Fix: added targeted CSS on #declaracao_veracidade (transform:none, overflow:visible, fixed 18px size, accent-color) and on the parent label (overflow:visible, display:flex, align-items:flex-start, gap:6px). Verified: all 4 sides visible, toggle functional, layout aligned inline with text.
